key: g0|CMS2FHIRPCSDepScreenAndFollowUp.Most Recent Adolescent Depression Screening Positive and Depression Management Active
reason: CMS2v16's new path: a positive adolescent screen counts with active depression management (Active Depression Management, 2.16.840.1.113762.1.4.1248.413). CMS's 2026 logic has no such define.

key: g0|CMS2FHIRPCSDepScreenAndFollowUp.Most Recent Adolescent Depression Screening Positive and Depression Medication Active
reason: CMS2v16 (and v15) count a positive adolescent screen with an active depression medication over or after the encounter. CMS's FHIR draft folded that MedicationRequest into the follow-up union instead, so it has no define of this name.

key: g0|CMS2FHIRPCSDepScreenAndFollowUp.Most Recent Adult Depression Screening Positive and Depression Medication Active
reason: CMS2v16 (and v15) count a positive adult screen with an active depression medication over or after the encounter. CMS's FHIR draft folded that MedicationRequest into the follow-up union instead, so it has no define of this name.

Now in the numerator, through v16's active-medication path. Aged 18, a positive adult screen on 2026-06-15 and a visit on 2026-06-21; an antidepressant order (doxepin, status active) authored 2025-06-24 with no dosage or supply stated. CMS's draft counts the order only as a follow-up, timed by its order date a year before the visit, so not in the numerator. v16 counts a depression medication active over and after the visit with no timing on the order: CMS's own medicationRequestPeriod() overlap condition holds for this order (the draft evaluates the same condition inside its follow-up union, which holds this order too).

key: g0|CMS2FHIRPCSDepScreenAndFollowUp.Follow Up Intervention for Positive Adult Depression Screening
reason: The follow-up union's medication branch is the order alone in v16 ("Medication, Order"): an active depression-medication order. CMS's draft also required a positive, recent adult screen and a medication period over the visit, which this case's adult side does not have. No population moves: the numerator reads the union only beside a positive recent screen of the same age group.
